Cannabis is something people try at the very start of an aura, while they're still awake enough to vape or smoke on purpose. What it does seems to depend on the person and on how much THC is in it. Some say it stops the seizure from going any further, and one woman's EEG showed fewer seizure discharges on the days she smoked. The people who say it brought seizures on mostly name THC vapes and concentrates, though. And in rats that get absence seizures, the brief staring kind, high-THC smoke made them worse while injected CBD cut them by about half.

Anything that could let someone hurt themselves in the next five minutes takes priority, so get the car keys out of reach and turn the stove off, and move them away from roads and balconies, or pools of water for that matter. Put any weapons away and keep the person away from crowds and strangers. If they want to post their big revelation about the universe, or message an ex, take the phone.

They can walk around all they like, since pacing helps some people work off the fear. Just no more of whatever they took, because more only makes it stronger and longer. A confrontation can wait until it's worn off. And if they're set on leaving, someone goes along so they're never out there on their own.
